priority: Replace the front-left tire: a foreign object is confirmed. Rear-left cracking warrants replacement; its tread and pressure remain unmeasured.

overview.title: TIRES
overview.observation: A foreign object is confirmed in the front-left tire. Rear-left cracking is significant; its tread was not measured.
overview.action: Replace front-left tire. Rear-left replacement recommended; verify fitment.

overview.title: WHEELS
overview.observation: Cosmetic curb rash was recorded on the front-left rim. No structural damage was reported on the visible surfaces.
overview.action: Cosmetic repair is optional. Investigate any new vibration or air loss.

overview.title: BODY DAMAGE
overview.observation: Left front fender dent [B1] and right front door scratch [B2]. The mapped damage is cosmetic.
overview.action: Use map markers 1 and 2 to locate recorded damage.

overview.title: FITMENT
overview.observation: Rear-left tire size differs from the confirmed rear placard specification. No approved alternative was documented.
overview.action: Fit the specified tire or verify an approved alternative.

overview.title: UNAVAILABLE MEASUREMENTS
overview.observation: The self-inspector could not measure rear-left tread or pressure. The other three tire readings were recorded.
overview.action: Measure before relying on that tire condition assessment.

overview.title: INSPECTION SCOPE
overview.observation: This inspection covers tires, wheels and in-scope cosmetic body areas. Mechanical systems and bumpers are outside scope.
overview.action: Choose Complete Inspection for the broader checklist.

limitations: Self-inspection. Rear-left tread and pressure were unavailable; no measurement was inferred from a photo. Brakes, engine, interior, road test and bumpers are outside the Dents & Tires scope.

full_findings.title: T1 | Front-left tire - foreign object
full_findings.text: A foreign object was confirmed in the tread. Replacement is required under this report program policy, whether or not the tire retains pressure. Measured tread: 5/32 in (3.96875 mm before display rounding). Pressure: 34 psi, cold. Rim: cosmetic curb rash. Evidence E01.

full_findings.title: T2 | Rear-left tire - cracking and fitment
full_findings.text: Significant cracking and a size discrepancy were recorded on the rear-left tire. Replacement is recommended and fitment must be verified. Tread and pressure were unavailable to the self-inspector; no measurements have been inferred. DOT: 0519. Evidence E02.

full_findings.title: B1 | Left front fender - damage marker 1
full_findings.text: Shallow dent with intact finish, recorded as cosmetic damage. Consider cosmetic repair if desired. Evidence E03.

full_findings.title: B2 | Right front door - damage marker 2
full_findings.text: Surface scratch without exposed metal. Cosmetic repair is optional. No photo was supplied in this fictional example.

full_findings.title: Front Right tire - recorded measurements
full_findings.text: Tread 6/32 in (4.7625 mm), cold pressure 34 psi, tire size 225/50R17, load index 98, speed rating V, DOT 0224. No visible cracking, uneven wear, tire damage or wheel damage recorded; size matches the confirmed reference.

full_findings.title: Rear Right tire - recorded measurements
full_findings.text: Tread 6/32 in (4.7625 mm), cold pressure 34 psi, tire size 225/50R17, load index 98, speed rating V, DOT 0224. No visible cracking, uneven wear, tire damage or wheel damage recorded; size matches the confirmed reference.
